sections.description:
🔒 Secure Your WordPress Content in 30 Seconds
The most powerful password protection plugin trusted by 40,000+ sites with more 5-star reviews than any competitor.

Highlights:
– ⚡ One-click password protection
– 🎯 Partial content locking (unique to PPWP)
– 🏗️ Native page builder blocks (Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder)
– ⭐ More 5-star reviews than any other password plugin

👉 View Documentation | Get Pro Version

An Inside Look at Password Protect WordPress – PPWP Pro

📊 What Makes PPWP Different

🚫 WITHOUT PPWP: WordPress default → Only 1 password per page → Can’t protect sections → No tracking → Breaks with page builders

✅ WITH PPWP: Unlimited passwords → Protect paragraphs, not just pages → Full analytics → Native builder modules → Works with all caching

Exclusive PPWP features no other plugin offers:
• Partial content protection – Lock specific sections (Free!)
• Native page builder modules – Not just shortcodes (Free!)
• Quick Access Links – Bypass URLs for VIPs (Pro)
• Password analytics – Track every access attempt (Pro)

Usage Note: This plugin protects content access, not direct file URLs. For complete media protection, pair with Prevent Direct Access Gold (https://preventdirectaccess.com/features/?utm_source=wp.org&utm_medium=pda-gold-link&utm_campaign=ppwp-free).

🎯 Why PPWP Dominates Password Protection

❌ The Problem with WordPress Default & Other Plugins:
– Can only protect entire pages (no partial protection)
– Limited to ONE password per page (that never expires)
– No usage tracking or analytics
– Break with page builders and caching
– No role-based access control
– Zero password management features

✅ The PPWP Advantage:
– Partial Content Protection – Lock paragraphs, not pages (exclusive feature!)
– Sitewide Protection per page/post with role-based control
– Unlimited passwords per page/post with role-based control
– Complete analytics – See who accessed what, when (Pro)
– Native page builder modules – Not just shortcode hacks
– Smart caching compatibility – Works with all major plugins
– Professional management – Import/export, bulk operations, expiration

🤔 Why You Need Professional Password Protection

With WordPress powering 43% of the web and cyber threats rising rapidly, protecting your valuable content is essential. But here’s the problem: WordPress requires creating user accounts for access control, which is overkill for many use cases.

PPWP solves this: Password protect any content without creating user accounts. Perfect for:
– Photographers sharing client galleries
– Businesses protecting internal docs temporarily
– Developers securing staging sites
– Creators offering premium content
– Anyone who needs quick, simple access control

The Problem: WordPress’s built-in password protection is severely limited – only ONE password per page, can’t protect sections, and offers zero tracking or management.

The Solution: PPWP transforms WordPress into a professional content security platform with features no other plugin offers.

⚡ Features That Make PPWP #1

🆓 FREE Forever Features

✨ Multiple Passwords Per Page/Post
The plugin extends WordPress’s limited password protection and allows you to set unlimited passwords per page. What’s more, you can protect content with just a single click – a random password will be automatically generated for you. Perfect for giving different access levels to different user groups.

👥 Password Protection by User Roles
Set different passwords for different user roles – one for subscribers, another for editors, another for clients. This granular control means you can manage access based on user privileges without complex membership plugins.

📝 Partial Content Protection (Exclusive to PPWP)
Unlike any other plugin, PPWP lets you password protect certain sections of a page or post instead of hiding the entire content. Create teasers of premium content that encourage visitors to register/sign up. Simply wrap your content:
[ppwp passwords=”your-password”]Your protected section here[/ppwp]

🔒 Section Protection for Page Builders
Take partial protection further with Section Protection – a more advanced feature than standard PCP:
– Add password-protected sections even on custom post types
– Works with templates created by Elementor, Divi, and other builders
– No more compatibility issues or workarounds
– Protect builder-specific elements like rows, columns, and modules

⏰ Time-Based Content Access
Control when protected content becomes available. Perfect for scheduled content releases, limited-time offers, or course drip content:
[ppwp passwords=”123″ on=”2024/12/25 09:00:00″ off=”2024/12/31 23:59:59″]
Christmas week exclusive content
[/ppwp]

🛡️ reCAPTCHA Integration
Stop password sharing and brute force attacks. Integrates Google reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 to ensure real humans are accessing your content while maintaining a smooth user experience.

⚡ AJAX Unlock (No Page Refresh)
Users see protected content instantly without page reloads. This modern approach improves user experience and avoids caching conflicts that plague other plugins.

📁 Category Protection
Protect all posts in a category with one password. When users unlock one post, they automatically get access to all posts in that category – perfect for course modules or content series.

🌐 Sitewide Protection
Lock your entire WordPress site with a single master password. All pages, posts, and custom post types are secured (media files require our PDA Gold addon). Ideal for staging sites or internal documentation.

🔐 Master Passwords
When managing many protected posts, use master passwords to unlock multiple content pieces at once. Original individual passwords still work alongside master passwords – giving you maximum flexibility.

🎯 Smart Password Management
– Auto-expire passwords after specific date/time – perfect for time-limited access
– Usage limits – Set passwords to work only 3, 5, or X times
– Simultaneous access control – Limit how many users can use the same password at once (Pro)
– Central login form – One login page for all protected content (Pro)
– Frontend password management – Let users generate Quick Access Links and reset passwords themselves (Pro)

🏗️ Native Page Builder Integration
Not just shortcodes – actual modules for:
– Elementor: Search “Password Protection (PPWP)” element
– Beaver Builder: Find our dedicated PPWP module
– Divi Builder: Full support with UI coming soon
– WPBakery: Compatible with UI in development

Set passwords, whitelisted roles, and customize forms directly in your page builder!

🎨 WordPress Customizer Integration
Customize all password forms via the familiar WordPress Customizer:
– Change colors, fonts, and backgrounds
– Add your logo to sitewide protection
– Edit error messages and form instructions
– Choose from pre-designed themes
– Preview changes in real-time

👁️ Content Visibility Control
Hide protected content from areas where it shouldn’t appear:
– Recent Posts widgets
– Next/Previous navigation
– Search results
– XML sitemaps and RSS feeds
– Archive and category pages

The content remains accessible via direct URL but won’t clutter your public areas.

🍪 Smart Cookie Management
Control how long users stay logged in. Set custom expiration times or use session cookies that clear when browsers close. Perfect balance between security and convenience.

📰 RSS Feed Control
Choose whether protected content appears in RSS feeds. You can show excerpts, hide completely, or even make RSS feeds public while the site is protected.

💎 PRO Power Features

📊 Statistics Extension
Track every password attempt with detailed analytics:
– IP addresses and locations
– Browser and device info
– Success/failure rates
– Access timestamps
– Usage patterns

🔗 Quick Access Links
Generate unique bypass URLs that grant access without passwords. Perfect for email campaigns or VIP access. Each link can have usage limits and expiration dates.

🛒 WooCommerce Integration
– Password protect individual products or entire categories
– Secure entire shop page with single or multiple passwords
– Create passwords for virtual products – Automate digital product access
– Generate Quick Access Links for products – Perfect for VIP customers
– Member-only products – Exclusive items for specific customer groups
– Sell passwords as products – Monetize your protected content

📧 Forms Integration
Automate access through form submissions:
– Send Quick Access Links after form submission (Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7)
– Unlock protected content automatically when users submit forms
– Perfect for lead generation – users get instant access after providing their email
– Restrict password/link usage per form submission

🚫 Smart Restrictions
Advanced access control:
– Simultaneous usage limits – Control how many users can use one password at the same time
– User-based restrictions – Limit passwords to specific WordPress users
– IP-based restrictions – Lock passwords to specific IP addresses
– Usage limits per password – Set max uses (3, 5, 10, etc.)
– Auto-expire after first use – Password becomes invalid after initial access
– Device restrictions

📤 Password Suite
Professional password management toolkit:
– Import/export passwords via CSV – Bulk operations made easy
– Require additional fields – Add username, email, or custom fields to password forms
– Central password login form – One login location for all protected content
– Frontend Quick Access Link generation – Let users create their own access links
– Customize Quick Access Links – Brand your bypass URLs
– Frontend password reset – Users can reset passwords without admin help
– Bypass sitewide protection – Create exceptions with Quick Access Links

👥 Group Protection
Manage team or membership access efficiently:
– Mixed content groups – Protect pages, posts, and custom post types together
– Unlock all at once – One password unlocks entire content groups
– Partial sitewide protection – Protect sections of your site while keeping others public

🏗️ Deep Page Builder Integration

Not just shortcodes – actual native modules:

🟦 Elementor: Search “Password Protection (PPWP)” element
🟧 Beaver Builder: Find our dedicated PPWP module
🟪 Divi Builder: Full support with UI coming soon
🟨 WPBakery: Compatible with UI in development

💡 Real-World Use Cases

📸 Use Case #1: Photographer Portfolio Protection
Share client galleries securely without worrying about unauthorized access. Generate unique passwords for each client, track who viewed which galleries, and impress them with a professionally branded login screen. Your work stays private until clients pay.

📚 Use Case #2: Premium Content Monetization
Transform your blog into a revenue generator. Use partial content protection to show teasers of premium articles, eBooks, or courses. Track password usage to prevent sharing, set expiration dates for time-limited access, and integrate with WooCommerce to sell passwords automatically.

🔧 Use Case #3: Client Project Management
Keep development sites and client deliverables secure. Password protect staging sites, share documentation with specific team members, and use Quick Access Links for clients who struggle with passwords. Perfect for agencies managing multiple projects.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Use Case #4: Private Family Blogs
Create a secure space for family memories. Share photos, videos, and stories without worrying about privacy. Generate unique passwords for each family member, hide content from search engines, and keep precious moments truly private.

🎓 Use Case #5: Online Course Delivery
Deliver course content professionally. Use category protection for course modules, time-based access for drip content, and track student progress through access logs. Integrate with your LMS or run standalone.

🛍️ Use Case #6: WooCommerce VIP Products
Create exclusive member-only products and categories. Offer special deals to subscribers, run password-protected flash sales, or provide early access to new products. The WooCommerce integration handles everything seamlessly.

sections.faq:
❓ Will this slow down my site?
No! PPWP is highly optimized with minimal impact. The AJAX unlock feature actually improves performance by avoiding page reloads. We’re compatible with all major caching plugins.

❓ Can I protect WooCommerce products?
Yes! The Pro version fully integrates with WooCommerce – protect individual products, entire categories, or your whole shop. You can even sell passwords as products.

❓ What happens to my content if I deactivate the plugin?
We include a restore feature that converts content back to WordPress default passwords before deactivation, ensuring your content remains protected.

❓ Works with my page builder?
Yes! We have native modules for Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and support for WPBakery. No more shortcode workarounds – use our visual modules directly in your builder.

❓ Can Google still index my protected content?
You have full control. Choose whether protected content appears in search results, sitemaps, and RSS feeds through our visibility settings.

❓ What about password sharing?
Pro features prevent abuse: track who uses each password, limit usage counts, restrict by IP, and use reCAPTCHA to stop automated attacks.

❓ Is there a limit on protected pages?
No limits! Protect unlimited pages, posts, and products. Create unlimited passwords. No restrictions on your content security.

❓ How is support?
Exceptional! Our customers consistently praise our support team. Free users get WordPress.org forum support, Pro users get priority email support with typical 12-hour response times.
